author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hello, fellow forum users!
Today, from motivation from another map maker creating a similar style of map, I decided to try it myself. I then turned out with something much better than expected, so I decided to post it here. This is my second time making a map, so I know it isn't perfect, hence leading me to ask for suggestions and your thoughts on the map and how it can be improved. If people like it, I will make a YML for it, as well. For anyone who cares to share their opinion on it, thank you! ^_^

Pictures: http://imgur.com/h5l0uGD,g8GzMju,sHaiDFa,K53bETL,67urrCk
Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/d20nz42c4knqqwt/Fractal.zip?dl=0
